answer: The design leans on asynchronous consensus epochs backed by multi-party quorum signatures. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the haven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the hollow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the pigment of the next round. Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short.
